intent: Daily digest generation via pg_cron at 06:00 WIB, DIGEST_MODEL completion, storage in digests table, and notification dispatch to digest.receive holders.
summary: Implemented the Daily Digest subsystem (PSI-077). CODE: (1) Migration 20260928230000_m11_daily_digest_cron.sql: schedules pg_cron job 'daily-digest' at 06:00 WIB (23:00 UTC) calling public.internal_post('functions', 'daily-digest'). (2) Edge Function supabase/functions/daily-digest/: index.ts & digest.ts: guards internal secret, aggregates last 24h activity_log, today's calendar events, and overdue/in-progress tasks, formats prompt, invokes _shared/llm.ts complete() with DIGEST_MODEL (default anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 or hermes), inserts summary into public.digests, queries users with 'digest.receive' permission, and invokes notify() RPC with type 'digest.ready' linking to /dashboard/overview?digest=<id>. (3) Overview UI: src/features/overview/components/daily-digest-card.tsx, src/features/overview/actions.ts getLatestDigestAction(), and src/app/dashboard/overview/layout.tsx displaying the briefing directly on the Overview page for authorized users with expand/collapse and model badges. (4) Unit tests: 4 tests in supabase/functions/daily-digest/digest.test.ts, 2 tests in src/features/overview/__tests__/overview-digest.test.ts. Suite: 113 frontend tests pass, 22 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.
